introHtml: Custom pocketed lunch bags, boxes, and totes give your team or event guests a place to store utensils, napkins, or a phone alongside their meal. Models like the Poly Pro Lunch Box and the Ridge Lunch Cooler include exterior mesh or zippered pockets that keep small items accessible without digging through the main compartment. For corporate giveaways or safety manager-led crew incentives, these extra pockets add daily utility that keeps your logo visible throughout the workday.
